description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages can execute arbitrary code.
SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets (EternalBlue). Used in WannaCry and NotPetya.
MOVEit Transfer SQL injection vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to gain unauthorized access to the database.
Microsoft Exchange Server SSRF vulnerability (ProxyLogon) allows unauthenticated attackers to send arbitrary HTTP requests and authenticate as the Exchange server.
Heartbleed: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat extension allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via crafted packets.
Apache Struts Jakarta Multipart parser allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via crafted Content-Type header. Used in Equifax breach.
BlueKeep: Remote Desktop Services remote code execution vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code.
Zerologon: Netlogon elevation of privilege vulnerability allows attackers to establish a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller.
PrintNightmare: Windows Print Spooler remote code execution vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.
Follina: Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) remote code execution vulnerability exploited via malicious Office documents.
Microsoft Outlook elevation of privilege vulnerability allows attackers to steal NTLM hashes via specially crafted emails without user interaction.
PAN-OS command injection vulnerability in GlobalProtect feature allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
VMware vCenter Server remote code execution vulnerability in vSphere Client allows attackers to execute commands with unrestricted privileges.
Spring4Shell: Spring Framework remote code execution vulnerability via data binding on JDK 9+.
HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack: allows attackers to conduct DDoS attacks by exploiting stream cancellation feature.
Fortinet FortiOS out-of-bounds write vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution via specially crafted HTTP requests.
F5 BIG-IP iControl REST authentication bypass vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
Microsoft MSHTML remote code execution vulnerability exploited via malicious Office documents using ActiveX controls.
Cisco IOS XE web UI privilege escalation vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to create accounts with level 15 access.
regreSSHion: OpenSSH server race condition vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
